spec_match.rationale: Probes support where it must be probed — inside a real dedicated worker — via supportedEntryTypes and a real observe() call, and explicitly teaches that observe() silently skips unknown types (so acceptance alone is a false-support probe).

interactive.rationale: Button spawns a fresh worker per probe; all three panels update from the worker's postMessage.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises both worker-context answers over postMessage; delivered plus the window contrast panel.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the accepted-but-type-unsupported trap (found live during verification and fixed), outright rejection, worker timeout, and the window-vs-worker contrast.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5387465121726464 plus explainer, LoAF spec, and the Chrome guide.

conformance.rationale: Suite asserts main-thread baseline, worker supportedEntryTypes membership, worker observe acceptance, a real blocked-worker entry, and no main-thread regression — all self-contained worker checks.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP runs: worker reported [mark, measure, resource] with observe() 'accepted' — which exposed the false-support trap in the page's first copy; fixed to require supportedEntryTypes membership and re-verified from a fresh reload; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: loafw-probe-ran asserts with the worker's readings.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; emerald/rose verdicts on paper (AA).

accessibility.rationale: Panels are aria-live labelled text; native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Single-column panels with wrapping; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the true-support readout on Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: On a supporting engine the worker's set should include long-animation-frame and the observe verdict should flip to the and-the-type-is-supported branch.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout updates aria-live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce async probe results via live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All three panels are role=status aria-live.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap long type lists inside bordered panels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: overflow-wrap on values; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the harness caught the observe()-silently-ignores-unknown-types trap in the page's own first copy — the exact false-support-probe class the anti-regression rules name — and the fixed page now requires supportedEntryTypes membership before claiming watchability. Re-verified fresh on both viewports.
